declarations.name: VeraSpinner
declarations.description: Shows that something is busy: an animated arc, decorative to assistive technology, whose label is announced once through the document's one polite live region when the wait lasts past a short settle window, so a fast load says nothing.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What is busy, said once by a screen reader when the wait outlasts the settle window (about 150 ms). Spinners with the same label are one load: said once however many there are, or however often a framework replaces them. Nothing is said inside an aria-busy="true" owner, which speaks for itself.

attributes.name: done-label
attributes.description: Said once when the load ends (a settle window after the last spinner with its label leaves), and only if its label was said.

attributes.name: show-label
attributes.description: Present: the label is also shown, as plain text after the arc.

cssParts.name: arc
cssParts.description: The turning arc (aria-hidden). Under reduced motion it pulses instead.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The shown label, rendered only with show-label and a label.
